**Job Description & Summary**

At PwC, our people in data and analytics focus on leveraging data to drive insights and make informed business decisions. They utilise advanced analytics techniques to help clients optimise their operations and achieve their strategic goals.

**Responsibilities** **:**

• Develop, maintain, and enhance Dotnet applications, Web API.

• Design and implement SQL Server databases.

• Utilize Azure Functions for serverless computing.

• Integrate and manage Azure Service Bus for messaging.

• Develop data pipelines using Azure Data Factory.

• Work with NoSQL databases for scalable data solutions.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.

• Troubleshoot and resolve application issues

**Mandatory skill set** **s:**

• Proficiency in C# .NET and Azure PAAS services.

• Strong hands-on experience with SQL Server.

• Experience in building and deploying Azure Functions and managing Service Bus.

• Familiarity with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for ETL processes.

• Exposure to NoSQL databases such as Cosmos DB or MongoDB.

• Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and integration patterns.

• Ability to write clean, maintainable, and scalable code.

• Strong debugging and performance tuning skills.

**Preferred skill sets** **:**

* Exposure to **containerization** technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

* Understanding of **security best practices** in cloud applications.

* Experience with **unit testing frameworks** like xUnit or NUnit .

**Years of experience required** **:**

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Information Technology, or a related field.

• Proven experience as a Dotnet Developer.

• Strong knowledge of SQL Server

Btech/MCA/MBA
